Name: Grumpy Cat
Author: DarkKassanova
Description:
This mod replaces your original cat's texture with Tar Tar Sauce (a.k.a. Grumpy Cat)!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4ETwx45.png[/img][img]http://i.imgur.com/LX8y9Ou.png[/img]

[b][u]To Install:
[/u][/b]1. Backup your cat.xnb located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
2. Download and extract the new cat.xnb
3. Replace your old one with the new one!
